payload.summary: clearlyNonClinicalConsumerPattern refuses in-corpus psychiatric queries on bare consumer tokens, the same defect as the topic denylist
payload.detail: Found while fixing #000GN4 (2026-09-02, probed against the real analyzeClinicalQuery on main at 45a3dcacb54a). src/lib/rag/rag-query-guard.ts:3-4 short-circuits any soft-tail-eligible query matching bare tokens including phone, car, tv, television, restaurant, holiday, hotel, flight, kitchen and laptop. Measured, with shouldShortCircuitUnsupportedSearch on the real analyzer: 'phone contact after discharge' short-circuits to zero retrieval while 'telephone follow up after discharge' reaches retrieval, and the word 'phone' is the only difference. Post-discharge phone contact is a topic this repo actively builds for - see the Caring Contacts work. Also confirmed refused by the pattern alone, with confidence and expandedTerms both above the soft-tail thresholds so the pattern is the sole cause: 'restaurant avoidance in social anxiety', 'car accident trauma assessment', 'tv watching and negative symptoms', 'holiday leave from the ward'. Separately, the token 'flight' matches 'flight of ideas', a core sign of mania, though that query would short-circuit through the soft tail anyway. This is milder than #000GN4 because these tokens sit behind unsupportedSoftTailEligible rather than firing unconditionally, but the mechanism is identical: a bare token standing in for a topic judgement. FIX: the same shape as #000GN4 - replace bare tokens with phrases that cannot occur in a clinical question, or route the decision through classifyCorpusGrounding where the query is soft-tail eligible anyway. Protected RAG surface: needs the RAG impact declaration, the clinical governance preflight, and an eval:quality --rag-only run, since the consumer controls in rag-eval-cases.ts (coffee machine, air fryer, overnight oats) are what this pattern pins. Note unavailableDocumentNoisePattern was checked in the same pass and is clean - every entry there is a multi-word phrase.
